steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: What exactly is a knight competition?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Mr. Szewczyk, what do you think?

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: ...Forget the song and dance, Czarny, I'm busy.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Out with it. What are you up to?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: I'm very sorry to say... the Roar Knightclub has decided to switch you out of pole position in their starting lineup for the Major. Their new safeguard knight ranks highly just as you do, and his Arts should be useful to the team.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: This... is nothing like what we agreed...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Of course, your down payment will still clear. But the rates for a knightclub's reserve are an invariably different question. You understand this, correct?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Now, now... don't make any hasty moves. Your child is celebrating a tenth birthday soon, I hear. You needn't lose your job now over assaulting someone as insignificant as myself...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Roar Knightclub will still be paying you plenty. You needn't make any efforts for at least the rest of the year.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: I need the lineup corrected, for God's sakes! I...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: That'll be up to your own performance, Szewczyk. There's always a way to live on, is there not?

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: ...You're not wrong.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: You could've just sent out any old envoy to tell me this. Why'd you need to meet me personally? Are all spokespeople this bored for something to do?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Ah... don't misunderstand me. I didn't come out here specifically for you. I was only here to make sure of some event arrangements.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: It seems we've been a little lax in parts. Our divisions have each encountered very minor bumps in the road, which some offenders are seeing fit to take advantage of.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: ...Are you threatening me? Threatening 'Plastic' Knight Szewczyk to take on your dirty work?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Nothing of the sort.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Then what are you trying to do here?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Right now, I have two particular knights who are currently working to enter the arena... but, unfortunately, they clearly do not have the points to do so.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Pfah... If you want a knight to make it in, you have your ways...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Don't put it like that. There are times one must respect the rules, and keep some conduct undisclosed—

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: —Making use of the law versus violating it is a night and day affair, after all. The fundamental difference lies in whether the parties involved possess the capacity to do so.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Just give it one nod of assent, and we'll add an event for the transfer of points, along with all its formalities. Of course, in much the same manner, I can settle of some of your complications with the Roar Knightclub...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: How would you feel about that?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: —OUT! The Strider Knight's sole-mount accelerator devices are non-functional! That sudden brake knocks him off right before the finish—!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: ACROSS THE LINE—! The winner, from Gloryfall Knightclub, is the Wisteria Knight! And right behind, Maria Nearl—hounding that medal!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: With his accelerators out, the Strider Knight has fallen all the way from second place to seventh—! It's not a good day to be the Strider!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: It just goes to show how crucial a knight's equipment is!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: And Ellen Select Technologies, who provide intimate maintenance, repair and upgrades to your equipment with their comprehensive member plans, have provided a no-expense-spared package for our knights!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Phew... runner-up, huh?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (This way... I'm another step closer to the Major...)

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (Auntie Zofia...)

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Oh, there's an unexpected customer.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Please, sit wherever you'd like.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Marcin... it's really you? That tremendous knight of days gone by runs this little bar now?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: They stripped old Marcin of his knighthood long ago. Now all he does is eat up his savings.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: How'd 'Plastic' Szewczyk find his way to this little place? Tell you the truth, this bar doesn't see all that many active knights in it.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: If you're tremendous past, Maria's tremendous present. They carried a story about your bar on the entertainment news last night.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Hmph... tremendous all around. I'll have a 'Red Edelweiss.'

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: This one's on me.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: My pleasure.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Roar Guards' training camp's a long way away. I won't let you waste the trip.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: So, you've come to enemy headquarters to spy on us, then? Right that old newspaper-worthy wrong for the Majors?

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: ...I'm not going to be in the Majors.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Huh... Roar Guards' decision? Thought you and your sponsors were on pretty good personal terms?

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Ha. Personal terms. Managing a relationship with a corp is like dating a Catastrophe.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: As always, the decision came from the next floor up...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Knights Association?

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Worse than that... try the General Chamber of Commerce.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Hum.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: I know what you want to say, Marcin. Up there, you're thinking, 'how's a tiny little Plastic Knight get into such a big mess?'

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: I still know my limits, and nobody goes this overkill on a knight who knows how to follow plans, so their problem is elsewhere.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: A rumor's spreading door-to-door. People saying the Radiant Knight was never even Infected, that her exile from Kazimierz was more complicated than that...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Like hell I know.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Put your guard down... I'm not probing you here, Marcin.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: I just want Czarny to learn there's a price to pay for pissing about with nobles... and I'm assuming he's got one eye on Maria Nearl too, doesn't he?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: ...The knights are joining hands and protesting the Association? This sort of thing won't ever end well.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: I'm just trying not to be ridden roughshod.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Thanks for the drink... Marcin, one last word... when I was young, it was watching your matches that made me finally decide to become a knight.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Went the wrong way back then, looks like.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: No. I'm ready to go my own way now, aren't I?

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: See you next time, old Marcin.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Szewczyk, my own last word... stay safe.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: ...Hmph. No knight ever needed to bow to the peddlers. Roar Knightclub'll see things my way.

steps.name: Flametail' Sona
steps.text: Hey, you've been tailing us for ages now. Time you showed your face, right?

steps.name: Flametail' Sona
steps.text: Oh, the overbearing type... No, I do NOT like fans like you...

steps.name: Flametail' Sona
steps.text: 'Wait—that bow—are you—?!'

steps.name: Flametail' Sona
steps.text: —Thought I'd say that and keel over, Armorless Union assassin?

steps.name: Flametail' Sona
steps.text: Hmm... so this is how you're molded. Way you dodge about everywhere, no-one's actually seen your looks before. Real gloomy line of work you're in...

steps.name: Flametail' Sona
steps.text: Don't get the chance everyday—

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: ...Hey.

steps.name: Flametail' Sona
steps.text: —to have a real scrap, you and us.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ah—auntie—

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Oh... uncle...

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: I look away from you for a second, and you somehow dig yourself even deeper.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: And when are you planning to stop?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: The leadership has been asking me time and time again about you. Every day I work in the Publicity Department is spent sorting out the trouble you cause... Half of my hours at work are lost to waiting for direction from the leadership.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Go to the Knights Association this moment and exit the tournament. You don't have the faintest idea what you're doing.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Is that what you wanted to say...

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: You will not kill yourself over this, Maria.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: You are a child of the Nearl family. You ought to know restraint.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: These annoyances all lie low in the face of the Major, so this is up to you to do, but you've already earned yourself plenty of attention.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Abandon the idea that you can force your way into the Major. Abandon, also, any idea that you've yet faced the strongest competition knights.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: But I don't want to just sit and watch while the Nearl family's nobility gets stripped—

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: —Vainglory.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: I've made it clear before that the Nearls do not need the approval of the Knights Association, obscene as it now is.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Have you somehow come to believe that without their recognition, our ancestors' deeds would cease to exist? Nonsense! For all these years, the Nearl family stood alone to defend our name!

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: What one cannot do, one must abandon. When one does not know how to give up... that blind alley is their end.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Uncle...

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Margaret has influenced you too much, Maria. She could never recognize her own ignorance, and you are not to blindly follow her example.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Don't give me that look. Have I said anything wrong? And surmounting the rulesetters within their own rules? Lunatic ravings.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: You know Margaret's temper. What she ultimately despised was the commercialization of the competition knights. I thought she had some backbone...

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: And what happened? Back against the wall, she still chose the path of competition, to flaunt her 'convictions.' Yes, indeed. 'Convictions.'

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: And could she change anything?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Uncle... don't talk about Margaret like this...

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: She could not.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: The one thing she changed was how the corporations treated the Nearl family! The one thing she accomplished was forcing my father, bedridden as he was, to clean up her mess!

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: 'The Radiant Knight' is a title she should've never been conferred! She has no power to shoulder any glory of the sort!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Uncle!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: So what about you...?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Aren't you... working for the corporations, even now?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: You forbid me from competing while you go play servant boy to the corporations and watch the Nearl family's knighthood slip away? You can stomach that?!

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: You're still young. For that, I won't blame your ignorance... but you should show respect to your elders.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: This again...

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: The skyscrapers... that the people of Kazimierz built, generation upon generation, cast the shadows that hide you in your hometown, shielded by your elders. What could you see from this safety?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Did you truly believe you had something? As nothing more than a young, fledgling knight?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: When the sun dawned over the frontier fortresses, the Ursus skyscrapers drew their line in the clouds on the horizon.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: The tower attendants recreated the motions of battle in the arena to please their nobles. The young steam knights donned the armor of old to temper and hone their skills.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Bounty hunters and robbers razed one destitute village after another, while the great cities were absorbed in hopes of building ever more arenas. One could call the harvest of a village versus the tax it pays comical.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: But all of that paled to the last sigh my father uttered on his deathbed. Not for Margaret, not for your parents—it was his lament given to all of Kazimierz.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: How could you not disappoint me?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: You're right, Maria, you're right. I am good for nothing, nothing more than a corporate, captive burdenbeast.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: So. What about you?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...Director? No, just a quick personal matter to tend to... No, of course work takes priority over personal...

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: The project meeting? Today? No, I didn't forget... Apologies, my greatest apologies, I'm very sorry, you're right...

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: I'll be back there momentarily... What? No, he doesn't understand the scope of the project... Yes, I'm sorry...

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Then if... If he could present in my stead... Yes, my apologies... The manager's responsibility? I... Yes, this will be the last time. No, there won't be a next time.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: You may terminate me if this happens again. Yes, of course, I promise.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: I am truly deeply sorry, Director.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...I do not have much time to waste, Maria. Give me an answer, now.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: You won't change my mind, Uncle.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: You're just like Margaret... you disgust me.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Your parents would find no pride in you. Take some time to calm down. Start thinking hard about who you really are.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...Please, just stop talking!

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Ignorant of the world and its untold ways... Pray for blessings. That is all you have left.
